o.text: From Proto-Turkic *altï. Cognate with Old Turkic 𐰞𐱃𐰃 (l¹t¹i /⁠altï⁠/, “six”), Chuvash улттӑ (ulttă).
Borrowed from Russian банк (bank). Internationalism ultimately from French banque.

From Old Anatolian Turkish [script needed] (gönlek), Proto-Turkic *köyŋelek. Cognate with Karakhanid کُنکْلَکْ (köŋlek),
Turkish gömlek,
Gagauz gölmek,
Crimean Tatar kölmek,
Turkmen köýnek,
Khakas кӧгенек (kögenek),
Kyrgyz көйнөк (köynök),
Southern Altai кӱнек (künek),
Kazakh көйлек (köylek),
Uzbek ko'ylak,
Bashkir күлдәк (köldäk),
Tatar күлмәк (külmäk), etc.
Ultimately from Arabic اِسْتِهْزَاء (istihzāʔ). Cognate with Turkish istihza.
